newsitem.title: JAPAN: Builders get 13.3 pct fewer orders in Feb - group.
newsitem.headline: Builders get 13.3 pct fewer orders in Feb - group.

text.p: Orders received by Japan's large construction companies in February fell 13.3 percent to 1.33 trillion yen from the same time last year, marking the fourth consecutive month of declines, the Japan Federation of Construction Contractors said on Monday.
The industry group's survey covered 63 large construction companies.
The industry group said in a statement that private-sector and public-sector orders were both sluggish in February.
The data also included orders the member companies received abroad, the group said.
The Construction Ministry will release its construction orders statistics for February, covering 50 large construction companies, later on Monday.
For the year from April 1, 1997, many of the member companies of the industry group expect domestic orders to grow by zero to five percent from the previous year, the group said.
Many believe that orders from private companies will grow zero to five percent while orders from central and local governments will fall by up to five percent, the group said.
